title: Convergence | ECHO//100 Episode 99
description: Kavi stands at the nexus of a thousand fracturing timelines, wielding the power to weave them into one. As reality stabilizes, the antagonist Null faces an unexpected and permanent fate. Episode 99 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original fiction work.

scenes.text: The sky fractures, exposing a thousand shimmering realities bleeding into one singular, terrifying horizon.
scenes.caption: The sky fractures
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses stands on a floating platform looking at a sky filled with overlapping celestial dimensions.

scenes.text: Mira’s holographic form dissolves into golden light, stitching the jagged edges of space together.
scenes.caption: Mira sacrifices herself
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in her teal coat fading into glowing data particles, reaching toward Kavi one final time.

scenes.text: Kavi realizes the necessity of weaving every timeline into existence during this final night.
scenes.caption: Kavi takes control
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi raising his hands, strands of bright light flowing from his palms like cosmic thread.

scenes.text: Byte hovers nearby, scanning the chaotic data stream as the unified world takes shape.
scenes.caption: Byte monitors flow
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, the white floating bot with cyan face and orange antenna, observing the swirling energy currents.

scenes.text: Shadows coalesce as Null lunges from the void, hungry to consume the raw power.
scenes.caption: Null attacks
scenes.image_prompt: Null, a creature of black-purple glitch and glowing red eyes, striking at the center of the horizon.

scenes.text: Null strikes the wall of memories and vanishes, neutralized by the sheer density within.
scenes.caption: Null is consumed
scenes.image_prompt: Null being pulled into a vortex of swirling colorful memories, his red eyes fading to nothing.

scenes.text: The world settles into a calm, coherent glow as the final puzzle piece clicks.
scenes.caption: Reality stabilizes
scenes.image_prompt: A serene, unified landscape appearing behind Kavi, who remains centered in the now-stable horizon.

scenes.text: Kavi raises the dead phone, which vibrates with life, displaying a cryptic new message.
scenes.caption: The final message
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi holding a black smartphone that is now glowing with an ethereal white light, face illuminated.
